doc_title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
doc_title_jp: 自己株式の消却に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 自己株式の保有比率を発行済株式総数の5%程度を目安とする方針に基づく

summary_en: 930,000 ordinary shares to be cancelled effective 2026-08-31. Post-cancellation issued shares outstanding (ex-treasury): 29,227,184. Treasury thereafter 4.97% of issued. Cancellation authorised by board 2026-08-13 under Companies Act art. 178, reflecting policy to hold treasury at ~5% of issued stock.
summary_jp: 普通株式930,000株を2026年8月31日に消却予定。消却後の発行済株式（自己株式除く）は約2,922万株。自己株式保有比率を発行済株式総数の5%程度を目安とする方針に基づく。
tag_en: Share cancellation - 930,000 shares (2.84% of issued) - effective 2026-08-31
tag_jp: 自己株式消却 - 930,000株（発行済株式の2.84%）- 2026年8月31日予定

doc_title_en: Notice of Dividend Policy Change and Dividend Forecast Revision (Initial Dividend) for FY12/26
doc_title_jp: 配当方針の変更及び配当予想の修正（初配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 業績堅調、EBITDA過去最高。成長投資継続しつつ利益還元充実可能と判断

summary_en: Initial dividend: 18 yen/share in FY12/26 (period-end). Payout ratio target 30% from FY12/27 onwards. Discretionary share buybacks to continue.
summary_jp: 初配18円/株（FY12/26期末）。FY12/27以降の配当性向目安30%。自己株式取得も継続実施。
tag_en: Dividend policy – initial dividend 18 yen/share – payout ratio 30% target – FY12/26
tag_jp: 配当方針変更・初配 18円/株・配当性向30%目安・FY12/26
